description: This file defines API functions for interacting with document-related endpoints in a backend service. It includes functions for uploading, listing, updating metadata, generating download URLs, and deleting documents, specifically for a Business Loan Applicant Portal project.

methods.name: uploadDocument
methods.description: Uploads a supporting document, optionally linking it to a loan draft and including metadata, via a multipart/form-data POST request.

methods.name: listDocuments
methods.description: Fetches a list of supporting documents, optionally filtered by a specific loan draft ID.

methods.name: updateDocumentMetadata
methods.description: Replaces the metadata JSON string of a specified document via a PUT request.

methods.name: getDocumentDownloadUrl
methods.description: Constructs and returns a download URL for a specified document using the base URL.

methods.name: deleteDocument
methods.description: Deletes a specified document via a DELETE request.
